research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Metromile is researching systems and methods for determining vehicle trip information. This involves using mobile computing devices to detect the presence of a vehicle and verify trip details. These innovations align with Metromile's focus on leveraging data science and machine learning to enhance car insurance offerings, ensuring accurate and fair insurance assessments based on precise trip data.

overview_description.description: Metromile is a digital insurance platform in the United States. With data science as its foundation, Metromile offers real-time, personalized auto insurance policies by the mile, instead of the industry-standard approximations and estimates that have historically made prices unfair. Metromile’s digitally native offering is built around the modern driver’s needs, featuring automated claims, complimentary smart driving features, and annual average savings of 47% over what they were paying their previous auto insurer. In addition, Metromile Enterprise licenses its technology platform to insurance companies around the world. This cloud-based software as a service enables carriers to operate with greater efficiency, automate claims to expedite resolution, reduce losses associated with fraud, and unlock the productivity of employees.

about_short_description.short_description: Metromile is a car insurance company using data science and machine learning to offer drivers new and fairer insurance.

product.name: Pay Per Mile Car Insurance
product.description: A car insurance model where customers pay a base rate plus a per-mile charge, allowing for potentially lower costs for those who drive less.

product.name: Metromile Pulse
product.description: A device that plugs into a car's OBD-II port to track mileage and driving behavior, used to calculate insurance rates and monitor vehicle health.

product.name: Metromile App
product.description: A mobile application that allows users to view trips, monitor car health, receive alerts, and file insurance claims.

product.name: Comprehensive Coverage
product.description: Insurance that covers non-collision-related damages to a vehicle, such as theft, fire, or natural disasters.

product.name: Collision Coverage
product.description: Insurance that covers damages to a vehicle resulting from a collision, regardless of fault.

product.name: Liability Insurance
product.description: Coverage for damages or injuries caused to others in an accident where the insured is at fault.
